title: muscadinia rotundifolia
intro: Muscadinia rotundifolia, commonly known as Scuppernong grape, is a species of grapevine native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and alleviate symptoms of diabetes due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Muscadinia rotundifolia include its ability to act as an antidiabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
